sections.heading: Anil Ambani — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Anil Ambani was born on 4 June 1959 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Dhirubhai Ambani and his mother, Kokilaben Ambani. He is a sibling of Mukesh Ambani, Deepti Salgaocar and Nina Kothari.
He received his education at Warwick Business School, The Wharton School, University of Mumbai and Hill Grange High School.
